question: After role-preserved and matched role-broken observation pairs are frozen without physical vertex geometry, which literal critical-center correspondence edits distinguish preserved roles, and do those edit constraints transfer unchanged to Bavaria and LOC?

correspondence.coordinateSystem: center x/y normalized inside each frozen observation region
correspondence.matching: minimum-total-spatial-distance one-to-one assignment performed independently within vertex kind; smaller kind-set is matched completely and surplus vertices remain unmatched
correspondence.transformSelection: lowest mean matched spatial displacement across both kinds, ties by listed order; no role label used
correspondence.reason: sealed CENTER events retain center coordinates, kind and arm histogram but not target center IDs for each arm

editObservables.label: fractional surplus critical centers after same-kind correspondence
mean matched-center displacement without orientation normalization
mean matched-center displacement after blind D4 transform selection
whether best blind D4 alignment is non-identity
whether best blind D4 alignment uses a reflection
mean absolute degree change among matched endpoints
mean absolute degree change among matched junctions
mean normalized arm-histogram L1 change among matched endpoints
mean normalized arm-histogram L1 change among matched junctions
mean normalized arm-histogram L1 change among all matched critical centers

trainDiscovery.nullShuffle: preserved/broken labels within each physical occupant-family pair preserving positive count
trainDiscovery.selection: largest absolute family-pair-balanced rank effect in Cleveland only

transfer.descriptivePass: same balanced-effect direction in train, holdout and control, with absolute holdout and control effect each at least 0.08

falsifiers.replayMismatch: If selected-observation replay does not exactly reproduce the frozen full-world topology aggregates for every selected observation, vertex evidence is rejected.
falsifiers.noVertexSignal: If preserved and matched broken pairs have indistinguishable correspondence edits under train nulls, no local vertex-edit grammar is supported.
falsifiers.noTransfer: If train-selected edits reverse or collapse in Bavaria or LOC, they are not transferable edit constraints.
